g.text: 1. DESIGN CASE = SIMULATOR DESIGN POINT (NOISE OFF): FEED 40.0 t/h, 40.0 wt% PX, 20 °C; PRODUCT 6.19 t/h AT 99.90 wt%; REJECT 33.81 t/h AT 29.04 wt% PX.
2. ALTERNATIVE VERSION OF PX-PID-301. PX-PID-301/302/303 REMAIN THE REFERENCE FOR THE DCS CONSOLE, THE DECKS AND THE EXERCISES.
3. LINE SIZES FROM THE MODEL FLOWS (LIQUID ≤ 2 m/s, SLURRY ≤ 2.5 m/s, VAPOUR ≤ 20–25 m/s); CIRCULATION FLOW ASSUMED 2.5 × DRAW (TBC).
4. DESIGN PRESSURES AND PSV SET POINTS ARE ASSUMPTIONS (HOLD): JACKETS 20 barg vs C3= SETTLE-OUT 17.4 barg AT 45 °C (HAZOP R03).
5. TRANSMITTERS ARE DRAWN AS FIELD BUBBLES; ALL ARE INDICATED ON THE DCS. JI-106 IS INDICATED FROM JT-106 (SHARED WITH JSHH-106, NOTE B).
6. N₂ BLANKET, VACUUM PROTECTION AND TRACING ON THE GROWTH VESSELS NOT SHOWN (HOLD). CV BLOCK VALVES HV-1xx, BYPASS GLOBE (TYP.).
7. JACKET LIQUID-LEVEL CONTROL (C3= LETDOWN) IS IN THE K-501 PACKAGE; NOT MODELLED IN THE OTS (HOLD).
CONTROL AND INTERLOCK NOTES (SCHEDULE ON SHEET 4)
A. DIC-115 → SP OF TIC-110 → SP OF PIC-111 → PV-111 (CASCADE). LIC-113 → FV-114; LSLL-125 (5 %) FORCES FV-114 SHUT (DCS).
C. I-5 PSHH-105 (> 16 barg, 3 s) OR P-106 STOP → W-104 STOPS, FV-114 AND FV-108 FORCED SHUT.
D. ZIC-107 (WASH FRONT) → FV-108 PRODUCT DRAW; TIC-109 → TV-109 (FO) KEEPS THE MELT LOOP AT 18 °C.
E. FV-108 HAS BLOCK VALVES BUT NO BYPASS (SMALL PRODUCT LINE; A BYPASS WOULD DEFEAT THE WASH-FRONT CONTROL). TBC.
F. SIS LOGIC SOLVER SEPARATE FROM THE DCS (SRS TAB). FAIL POSITIONS: FC UNLESS MARKED FO.
